description: Write the LibKa Markdown to a folder and build it: the outputs the document asks for in its front matter (outputs: web, pdf, deck, docx; default web and pdf), or the outputs given here. Guard checks every output (the pages in Chrome, the PDF with veraPDF when Java and veraPDF are installed, the Word file's structure); passing outputs are signed. Returns the files and every Guard finding to fix. Writes files on this machine.

markdown.description: The document; or give path instead, not both

name.description: File name without extension when markdown is given (default: document)

outputs.description: Build these instead of the document's own outputs, e.g. ["web", "deck"] to check slide fit quickly

path.description: An existing .md file to build, only read (images are found next to it)

name: libka_build
title: Build a LibKa document
